text: To confirm that the final repository state still passes, the mocked backend suite, the dashboard suite and the extension suite were run again on 14 October 2026 while this report was prepared: 146 backend tests passed with 7 deselected (54.73 s), 22 dashboard tests passed and 24 extension tests passed. The ChromaDB integration test, the Playwright end-to-end test and the real-provider tests were not run again; their results are those of the recorded run.
